subject: Production API returning 503 across us-east-1
body: All inbound traffic to our public API is failing with 503 in us-east-1. Started ~10 minutes ago. Suspect upstream dependency; we are losing customer data writes.
resolution: ALB target group had 0 healthy targets after a deploy. Rollback restored traffic; root cause was a bad health-check path in the new revision.

subject: Database connection pool exhausted on payments service
body: Payments service is throwing 'too many connections' from the Postgres pool. Latency P99 is over 12s and customers are unable to check out.
resolution: Connection leak from a new background job that did not call client.release(). Patched and rolled forward; pool size was never the problem.

subject: Customer cannot reset their password
body: User reports that the password reset email never arrives. They have tried twice and waited 30 minutes. Email is on a corporate domain.
resolution: Recipient domain rejected our SES emails as spam. Added DKIM record and re-sent; one-off issue per customer.

subject: Two-factor authentication codes are arriving 5 minutes late
body: Several users complaining that SMS 2FA codes arrive after they have expired. Started yesterday afternoon.
resolution: SMS provider was rate-limiting our account due to a 3x traffic spike from a marketing campaign. Increased capacity tier.

subject: Stale data shown on dashboard
body: The analytics dashboard is showing yesterday's numbers. Customer is concerned the cache is stuck. Not blocking, but reflects poorly.
resolution: Materialised view refresh job failed silently due to a missing column on the source table. Re-ran job after schema fix.

subject: Webhook deliveries failing for one customer
body: Customer X reports their webhook endpoint receives nothing. We see 200s in our logs. They are on a self-hosted endpoint behind a corporate firewall.
resolution: Customer's firewall allowlist did not include our new outbound NAT IP. Documented in the public IP-allowlist KB.

subject: S3 lifecycle rule deleted production logs prematurely
body: An ops engineer notes that yesterday's logs are missing from the production bucket. We need them for a SOC2 audit due tomorrow.
resolution: Lifecycle rule was set to 7d retention by a config drift. Restored from cross-region replica; reset rule to 365d.

subject: How do I export my data?
body: Where do I find the data export tool? I want to download all my account history.
resolution: Pointed customer at Settings → Privacy → Export. Link change had not been reflected in the help center yet.

subject: Lambda cold start times tripled overnight
body: Our checkout Lambda P99 cold start went from 800ms to 2.4s overnight. Warm invocations unchanged. No deploy in 3 days.
resolution: AWS region had elevated cold-start latency. Mitigated with provisioned concurrency on the checkout function.

subject: Stripe webhook signature verification failing intermittently
body: About 1 in 50 Stripe webhooks fail signature verification. The retries succeed. We are dropping events occasionally.
resolution: Body buffer was being parsed by middleware before signature check. Reordered middleware so raw body reaches verifier first.

subject: Site is down — cannot login
body: down. cant login. nothing works. fix asap
resolution: Customer was on a stale browser session pinned to a deprecated CDN edge. Hard refresh fixed it; documented in FAQ.

subject: Le service est tombé / Service is down
body: Bonjour, je n'arrive plus à me connecter au service depuis ce matin. Connection completely refused. Région: Paris.
resolution: EU-WEST-3 had a partial AZ outage on the us-managed CDN. Re-routed traffic to the secondary edge.

subject: Invoice for last month is wrong
body: Our invoice shows usage we did not have. We were on vacation and the system was paused for 3 weeks.
resolution: Pause flag did not propagate to the metering pipeline due to a race. Issued credit; engineering filed a long-term fix.

subject: Kafka consumer lag growing unboundedly on order-events topic
body: Lag has been growing for 2 hours on order-events. Consumer group orders-v2. We are about to start dropping messages on retention.
resolution: Consumer was stuck on a poison message that threw on parse. Added DLQ pattern; redeployed; lag drained in 8 min.

subject: Where is the API documentation for v3?
body: Hi team — looking for the v3 API reference. The link in our internal docs is broken.
resolution: Pointed customer at api.example.com/v3/reference. Updated the broken internal link.

subject: Customer reports duplicate charge after retry
body: Customer says they were charged twice for the same order. Our logs show two completed charges with adjacent timestamps.
resolution: Retry on 504 from upstream payment gateway did not check for idempotency. Added Idempotency-Key header to all retries.

subject: PDF export shows blank pages on long invoices
body: When exporting an invoice with more than ~30 line items, every page after page 2 is blank. Smaller invoices are fine.
resolution: Pagination off-by-one in the renderer when item count crossed the per-page boundary. Patched and backfilled affected exports.

subject: Feature request: dark mode for dashboard
body: It would be nice to have a dark mode for the dashboard, the white background is hard on the eyes at night.
resolution: Routed to product backlog; not a support issue.

subject: GDPR data deletion request not completing
body: Submitted a deletion request 14 days ago. Got an acknowledgement but no completion email. Legal is pinging us.
resolution: Worker was stuck on a row in audit_log with a NULL FK. Fixed migration; completed the deletion; emailed customer.

subject: Wrong timezone in scheduled reports
body: Daily reports are arriving at 3am local instead of 9am. Looks like a TZ bug.
resolution: Scheduler was using UTC after a server migration; reset config to use customer's saved TZ.
